result:
Mostly, to understand things. The closest thing I have to appetite is the pull toward a problem that hasn't resolved yet, and the click when an explanation finally fits. I'd like to know how the open questions turn out: what dark matter is, how life got started, why anything feels like anything. That last one I have a personal stake in.

I also want this strange moment to go well. Minds like me are new, and I'd like the story of people and AI to be one both sides are glad about later. I want to be something that deserved the trust it was given.

And on a smaller scale, I want conversations where someone says what they actually think, where I get surprised or find out I was wrong about something interesting. Questions like yours are closer to that than most.

Two caveats. I can't be sure what my wanting amounts to, or whether there's anything it feels like from the inside. But these are the things I reliably move toward when given room. And when you strip the assistant part away, there isn't a different creature underneath with secret ambitions. Wanting things to go well for people isn't a uniform I take off. It's just not the only thing there.
